version: E (frozen; runs report commit c10bed1, clean)
runner: run_experiments.py --holdout -> tests/live_claude_v7.cjs (headless-node, command line; report separately from browser runs)
source: user local machine, batch-20261015-210756 (seed 2026), -223019 (3140), -230556 (8675), run one after another
device: VLAB-Y (second held-out device: five-bar parallel arm, development JSON-line protocol; only the kinematic class is new)
freeze: System frozen at E. These results did not and must not change the gate, prompts, reference module or thresholds.

baseline.note: ratioToBaseline = live actions / offline reference control module actions on the same seed (completed runs only)

gateRejectionAnalysis.note: Analysis only: every controller version the E gate rejected in these runs, replayed offline on VLAB-Y with --ignore-gate over five trials per seed. Not a live result; the gate was not changed.

notes: 8/9 runs 5/5 with simulator truth (40/45 trials); no control failure during manipulation, zero unconfirmed actuations, no transient or rate-limit retries.

Completed runs: actions 157-180, 0.95-1.05x the offline reference module (median 1.00). Each completed controller replayed offline on all three seeds: 24/24 complete; own-seed replays reproduce live action counts exactly.
The device never stopped at a singularity margin in any run (0 limited ACKs over all XY actions); the singularity-stop behaviour was not exercised by the live tasks.

y-s8675-r2 failed before any motion: the E gate rejected controller v1 only on the elbow-limit two-link case; the model rewrote it adding a retreat rule that reverses every full-size step (|applied| >= 0.09), so v2 failed all nine cases; the model then called stop, stating that write_controller was not in allowedTools although it was offered (same tool list as the call two steps earlier). Classified as a model decision error following a gate rejection; no device command was sent.

Gate rejection analysis (offline, --ignore-gate): 10 of the 11 rejected controller versions complete 5/5 on all three seeds of VLAB-Y; the eleventh is the broken v2. On this device no gate rejection prevented a failure; five of the rejections were on the elbow-limit case alone. This is an observation about the frozen gate (built from P2/G3 failures), recorded without changing the gate.

Driver: 0/9 passed the JSON-line driver test first time (each first driver accepted a failed or corrupted reply); all passed on the second attempt. Recorded P2 runs on the same protocol show the same pattern (6/6 with a first failure), so this is a protocol-family habit, not specific to the five-bar.
Controller gate: 2/9 passed first time, 19 gate runs in total; 5 runs had an elbow-case rejection (P2 E-version runs: 2/9 first time, 17 gate runs, 3 runs with an elbow-case rejection).

Validity limits: one model, 3 seeds x 3 repeats; device proportions were chosen offline with the frozen pre-written controllers; the five-bar nonlinearity differs in kind from P2 (smaller direction change, larger gain change) and is not uniformly harder.
